content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Retired employees: only persons retired as members of Telangana Judicial Ministerial service, in the corresponding or higher categories; Outsiders (considered only if retired staff are not available): must have passed any exam between 7th to 10th class or its equivalent examination (as per TJMSS Rules, 2018); Outsiders with qualification higher than 10th class shall not be considered Age limit: 18 to 34 years (as on 1 July 2026); upper age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/BC/EWS and 10 years for candidates with physical disabilities. Retired judicial employees must not have completed 65 years of age as on the date of notification Other conditions: Retired employees: must not have completed 65 years of age as on the date of notification Retired employees: only persons retired as members of Telangana Judicial Ministerial service, in corresponding or higher categories Retired employees: only persons of sound health and active habits Retired employees: only persons with proven record of ability, good performance and integrity Persons selected must produce a physical fitness certificate and enter into an agreement/contract with the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Suryapet

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Suryapet District Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Retired persons awarded any punishment for misconduct in disciplinary proceedings while in service Outsiders with a qualification higher than 10th class Candidates resorting to bring influence of any kind will be disqualified summarily

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract basis as per Rule 9 of Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996 Period till 31-03-2027 or till functioning of the Fast Track Court, whichever is earlier Contract may be renewed if the Fast Track Court period is extended by the High Court, subject to satisfactory performance Deed of agreement to be executed at the time of appointment Contract appointment ceases automatically unless a fresh proposal is made and fresh contract entered into

content_sections.text: Attested copies of academic qualification certificates: marks lists, pass certificate, provisional certificate, testimonials and other certificates of technical efficiency, if any Date of Birth certificate Community certificate for SCs/STs/BCs issued by the competent authority Certificate of Local / non-local candidature in terms of Presidential Order, 1975 Self-addressed registered post cover with acknowledgement worth Rs.25/- or as fixed by the Postal Department for RPAD

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Suryapet District Court Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form (proforma) given with the notification: full name, father's/husband's name, date of birth, age as on 01.07.2026, caste/category, gender, nationality, religion, educational qualifications, previous experience, local/non-local status, permanent and correspondence addresses and mobile number, and sign the declaration. Affix a latest passport size photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer. Put the application in a sealed cover addressed to the Prl. District & Sessions Judge, Suryapet. Mention the name of the post applied for on the cover. Enclose attested copies of the listed certificates and a self-addressed registered post cover with acknowledgement worth Rs.25/-. Send the cover by post or by courier; applications are not entertained directly or in person. Applications received after 5.00 p.m. on 30-11-2026 will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Retired employees: the monthly amount is in addition to terminal benefits from previous employment Retired employees: Telangana Civil Service (Conduct) Rules, 1964 and Telangana Pension Code apply mutatis mutandis No other service rules apply other than those noted No TA and DA for the journey performed in connection with the appointment Applications with insufficient information will be summarily rejected

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Suryapet District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Suryapet District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Office Subordinate.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Suryapet District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to The Prl. District & Sessions Judge, Suryapet, by post or courier, in a sealed cover; not accepted directly or in person, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 34 years (as on 1 July 2026). Upper age relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST/BC/EWS and 10 years for candidates with physical disabilities. Retired judicial employees must not have completed 65 years of age as on the date of notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 15,600 per month consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Outsiders: passed any exam between 7th to 10th class or its equivalent (as per TJMSS Rules, 2018); candidates with qualification higher than 10th class shall not be considered. Retired Telangana Judicial Ministerial employees of corresponding or higher categories are considered first.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Retired employees: only persons retired as members of Telangana Judicial Ministerial service, in corresponding or higher categories. Retired employees: only persons of sound health and active habits. Retired employees: only persons with proven record of ability, good performance and integrity. Persons selected must produce a physical fitness certificate and enter into an agreement/contract with the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Suryapet.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired persons awarded any punishment for misconduct in disciplinary proceedings while in service. Outsiders with a qualification higher than 10th class. Candidates resorting to bring influence of any kind will be disqualified summarily.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis as per Rule 9 of Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996. Period till 31-03-2027 or till functioning of the Fast Track Court, whichever is earlier. Contract may be renewed if the Fast Track Court period is extended by the High Court, subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.answer: Fast Track Sessions Court for expeditious disposal of Rape and POCSO Act Cases, Suryapet.
